evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: LLM agents increasingly rely on reusable skills to plan tasks, invoke tools, recover from errors, and complete workflows without modifying model parameters.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: On average, skill augmentation improves benign task accuracy by 10.3 percentage points (pp), but also increases unsafe action rate (UAR) by 10.3 pp.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: It compares agents with and without benign skills across five LLM backbones and three benchmarks under matched requests.
